safi-cedvel:1-5.t:
* I'rab:
(السماء) is the fāʿil (agent) of an omitted verb that the mentioned one after it explains, and likewise (الكواكب); (البحار) is the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being ثارت; (القبور) is the fāʿil of an omitted verb, its implied form being تبعثرت; (ما) is a relative noun in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object), and the returning pronoun is omitted.
Clause: «the condition, its verb and its apodosis ... » has no grammatical position, inceptive.
And the clause: « (انفطرت) السماء ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of a genitive construct) [Note: and likewise the remaining implied clauses.] .
And the clause: «انفطرت (the mentioned one) » has no grammatical position, explicative [Note: and likewise the clauses mentioned after إذا.] .
And the clause: «علمت نفس ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis of a non-jussive condition.
And the clause: «قدّمت ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (ما) .
And the clause: «أخّرت» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause قدّمت.

safi-cedvel:6-8.t:
* I'rab:
(أيها) is a vocative, a single proper noun, indeclinable (mabnī) on the ḍamma, in the position of an accusative; (الإنسان) is a badal (substitute) for أي, or ʿaṭf bayān (explicative apposition) to it, following it in the nominative in form; (ما) is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative, a mubtadaʾ (subject) whose khabar (predicate) is the clause غرّك; (بربّك) is attached to (غرّك); (الذي) is a relative in the position of a second naʿt (adjective) of ربّك; (الفاء) is a conjunction in the two places; (في أيّ) is attached to (ركّبك) [Note: or attached to an omitted ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of address in ركّبك.] , and (أيّ) is a jussive conditional noun [Note: or it is the "perfection" one (al-kamāliyya), with the clause شاء being an explanatory resumption; or an interrogative noun carrying the sense of reproach and rebuke for lack of insight, with the clause شاء being a naʿt of صورة with the connector implied, and the clause ركّبك an explanation.] , declinable; (ما) is redundant (zāʾida) [Note: or a jussive conditional noun in the position of an accusative, an advanced mafʿūl bihi.] ; (شاء) is a past verb in the position of a jussive, the protasis (fiʿl al-sharṭ), and likewise the apodosis ركّبك..
Clause: «النداء ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «ما غرّك ... » has no grammatical position, the answer to the vocative.
And the clause: «غرّك ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ما) .
And the clause: «خلقك ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the relative noun (الذي) .
And the clause: «سوّاك ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the ṣila clause.
And the clause: «عدلك ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause سوّاك.
And the clause: «شاء ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption.
And the clause: «ركّبك ... » has no grammatical position, the apodosis of the condition, not accompanied by الفاء.

safi-cedvel:9-12.t:
* I'rab:
(كلّا) is for rebuke and deterrence; (بل) is for a transitional turning-away (iḍrāb intiqālī); (بالدين) is attached to (تكذّبون); (الواو) is circumstantial, or resumptive; (عليكم) is attached to an advanced khabar (predicate); (اللام) is for emphasis; (حافظين) is the accusative ism (subject) of إنّ; (ما) is a maṣdar (verbal noun) particle [Note: or a relative noun in the position of an accusative, with the returning pronoun omitted.] ..
The interpreted maṣdar (ما تفعلون) is in the position of an accusative, mafʿūl bihi (direct object).
Clause: «تكذّبون ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «إنّ عليكم لحافظين ... » is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the pronoun of تكذّبون [Note: or resumptive, with no grammatical position.] .
And the clause: «يعلمون ... » is in the position of an accusative, another naʿt (adjective) of حافظين [Note: or a ḥāl from the pronoun in كاتبين, the operator in it being the sense of emphasis.] .
And the clause: «تفعلون ... » has no grammatical position, the ṣila (relative clause) of the particle-relative (ما) .

* Benefits:
- Your deeds are recorded against you: these verses indicate that the human being has guardians from among the angels assigned to him, who record against him his good or evil deeds, and they are aware of him in all his states. This is mentioned in Sūrat (Qāf) in His saying, the Exalted: (ما يَلْفِظُ مِنْ قَوْلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيْهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدٌ) , i.e. no speech issues from his mouth but a guarding angel and an attending angel become aware of it, wherever he is. They do not leave him except at the time of relieving himself, during intercourse, and when his major nakedness is exposed, for at those times they stay away from him. So it is not permissible for a person to speak in these two situations, so as not to harm the angels by their drawing near to him in order to write what he says. It is said that they write down everything he says, even his groaning in his illness; and it is said that they write only what carries a reward, or recompense, or punishment.
Al-Baghawī reported, with the chain of al-Thaʿlabī, from Abū Umāma, who said: The Messenger of Allah ﷺ said: "The writer of good deeds is the trustee over the writer of evil deeds. When he does a good deed, the one on the right writes it ten times; and when he does an evil deed, the one on the right says to the one on the left: Leave him for seven hours, perhaps he will glorify Allah or ask forgiveness."
It is worth mentioning that Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has no need to assign angels to His servants, for He is aware of everything, as in His saying, the Exalted: (وَلَقَدْ خَلَقْنَا الْإِنْسانَ وَنَعْلَمُ ما تُوَسْوِسُ بِهِ نَفْسُهُ وَنَحْنُ أَقْرَبُ إِلَيْهِ مِنْ حَبْلِ الْوَرِيدِ) ; but the recording of a person's deeds and words serves as evidence against him on the Day of Resurrection, just as his awareness of the angels' constant accompaniment increases him in awe, fear and closeness to Allah, Mighty and Majestic.

safi-cedvel:13-16.t:
* I'rab:
(اللام) is the shifted lām (al-lām al-muzaḥlaqa), for emphasis; (في نعيم) is attached to the khabar (predicate) of إنّ, and likewise لفي جحيم..; (يوم) is an accusative adverb of time, attached to (يصلونها); (الواو) is a conjunction; (ما) is a negative working like ليس; (عنها) is attached to (غائبين); (غائبين) is genitive in form, accusative in position, the khabar of ما..
Clause: «إنّ الأبرار لفي نعيم» has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «إنّ الفجّار لفي جحيم» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one.
And the clause: «يصلونها ... » has no grammatical position, an explanatory resumption [Note: or in the position of a genitive, a naʿt (adjective) of جحيم.] .
And the clause: «ما هم عنها بغائبين» has no grammatical position, conjoined to the clause يصلونها.

* Rhetoric:
Connection (al-waṣl): in His saying, the Exalted, «إن الأبرار لفي نعيم وإن الفجّار لفي جحيم» .
In the speech, among the requirements of connection is the agreement of the two sentences in being both declarative or both performative together with a link; that is, what joins them here is contrast.

safi-cedvel:17-19.t:
* I'rab:
(الواو) is resumptive; (ما) is an interrogative noun in the position of a nominative, a mubtadaʾ (subject), in the four places; (يوم) is the khabar (predicate) of the mubtadaʾ ما, the second and the fourth; the third (يوم) is attached to an omitted verb, its implied form being يجازون [Note: it may be a mafʿūl bihi (direct object) of an omitted verb, its implied form being أعني ("I mean").] ; (لا) is a negative; (لنفس) is attached to (تملك), by its implying the sense of "to put forward"; (الواو) is circumstantial; (يومئذ) is an adverb, accusative (or indeclinable), a badal (substitute) for the last يوم; (لله) is the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (الأمر) .
Clause: «ما أدراك ... » has no grammatical position, resumptive.
And the clause: «أدراك ... » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the mubtadaʾ (ما) .
And the clause: «ما يوم ... » is in the position of an accusative, the second mafʿūl bihi of the verb أدراك.
And the clause: «ما أدراك ... » has no grammatical position, conjoined to the resumptive one.
And the clause: «أدراك (the second) » is in the position of a nominative, the khabar of the third mubtadaʾ (ما) .
And the clause: «ما يوم الدين.. (the second) » is in the position of an accusative, the second mafʿūl bihi of the (second) verb أدراك.
And the clause: «لا تملك نفس ... » is in the position of a genitive, muḍāf ilayhi (the second term of a genitive construct).
And the clause: «الأمر ... لله» is in the position of an accusative, a ḥāl (circumstantial) from the fāʿil (agent) of تملك, the link being implied [Note: it may be resumptive, in which case it has no grammatical position.] .
